clips.prompt: A painterly, warmly lit animated scene in the style of a modern illustrated storybook, soft brush textures. A cosy farmhouse kitchen in the evening, a seven-year-old girl with brown plaits and red bobbles, in a mustard wool jumper, scrubs a small red boot over a bucket with a brush. Beside her sits her grandfather, white moustache, round glasses, flat cap, polishing his big brown leather boot with a cloth. They glance at each other and smile. Warm lamp light, steam on the window. Gentle slow camera drift. Tender, funny mood. No text.
clips.credit: Lotte and Opa: made with Gemini Omni

clips.prompt: A painterly, warmly lit animated scene in the style of a modern illustrated storybook, soft brush textures. Dusk in a snowy German village, a small, perfectly clean red child's boot standing alone on a stone doorstep in front of a wooden front door, lit by a warm yellow window beside it. Soft snowflakes fall. Slow camera push-in towards the boot. A faint footprint trail in the snow leads away. No people, no text. Hushed, hopeful mood.
clips.credit: A clean boot on the doorstep: made with Gemini Omni

clips.prompt: A painterly, warmly lit animated scene in the style of a modern illustrated storybook, soft brush textures. Early morning light through a front door. The same seven-year-old girl in her pyjamas and red hat crouches at the doorstep and pulls her red boot towards her: it is full of walnuts, a chocolate bar, gingerbread and two bright mandarins. Her eyes go wide, then she grins. Slow camera push-in. Joyful mood. No text.

clips.prompt: A painterly, warmly lit animated scene in the style of a modern illustrated storybook, soft brush textures. A poor stone cottage in the 4th century, in a warm Mediterranean night, a single candle glowing behind a small shuttered window. A hand in a plain brown sleeve, nothing else of the person visible, tosses a small cloth bag that glints gold through the window opening, then disappears into the dark. Slow sideways camera move. No faces, no text. Secretive, gentle mood.

clips.prompt: A painterly, warmly lit animated scene in the style of a modern illustrated storybook, soft brush textures. Close view of an old cloth sack being opened by weathered hands, out of it tumble mandarins, hazelnuts, gingerbread hearts and chocolate coins onto fresh snow. A birch rod hangs from the belt in the corner of the frame. Lantern light. Slow camera tilt up. No face visible, no text. Warm, amused mood.

clips.prompt: A painterly, warmly lit animated scene in the style of a modern illustrated storybook, soft brush textures. The same girl with brown plaits and the same grandfather, now at night in the hallway of their house. The girl in socks tiptoes to the front door where two boots stand side by side, a small red one and a big brown leather one, looks over her shoulder, and quietly slips a bar of chocolate into the big brown boot. Behind her in the dark doorway of the next room, the grandfather in his nightshirt and cap watches with a soft smile and puts a finger to his lips. Warm lamp glow, slow camera push-in. Tender, secret-gift mood. No text.
clips.credit: Made with Gemini Omni

clips.prompt: A painterly, warmly lit animated scene in the style of a modern illustrated storybook, soft brush textures. Early morning in a cosy hallway, soft golden light through the front door glass. The same grandfather with white moustache, round glasses and a flat cap, in a green loden jacket, bends and lifts his big brown leather boot from the doorstep and finds a bar of chocolate inside. He looks up across the hall at the same seven-year-old girl with brown plaits and red bobbles, who peeks round a doorway giggling. He slowly winks at her and tucks the chocolate into his pocket. Slow camera push-in. Tender, funny mood. No text.
clips.credit: Made with Gemini Omni
